workflow: A wrapper checks a dependent resource’s status by converting an externally supplied value to a boolean.
The conversion fails and records an exception, returning an error indicator.
The wrapper treats that indicator as a true status instead of stopping on the conversion failure.
It performs normal closed-resource handling and replaces or conflicts with the pending exception, producing an internal system error instead of propagating the original conversion/
summary: Unchecked status-conversion failure causes downstream error corruption
decision_reason: The failure workflow is materially the same as workflow-0044: a conversion helper reports failure with an exception pending, but the caller treats the failed result as usable and continues into downstream handling, causing an internal crash/error instead of propagating the recoverable conversion/л
